title.zh: v2.0.64 三端架构起步：功能层与界面层解耦，并加分层门禁守住它
title.en: v2.0.64 Starting the Three-Surface Architecture: Decoupling Logic from Presentation, With a Gate to Keep It

highlights.zh: **为什么现在做**：手机端 UI/交互/功能将重做，三端将来会有不同界面、不同交互、甚至不同功能集合（PC 最全）。这只有在**功能层不依赖任何一种界面的形状**时才做得起——否则三端就是一个程序加三套皮肤，每个功能都要写三遍。
highlights.en: **Why now**: the phone UI, interactions and features are being redesigned, and the three surfaces will end up with different interfaces, interactions and even different feature sets (PC fullest). That is only affordable if the logic layer does not depend on any one interface's shape — otherwise the three surfaces are one program with three skins, and every feature costs three times.

highlights.zh: **先说好消息（实测）**：`src/features/` 与 `src/hooks/` **原本已经没有任何文件 import React 组件**。底子比预想的好得多，所以本轮不是大重构，而是把仅剩的几处耦合清掉并把边界固定下来。
highlights.en: **First, the good news (measured)**: `src/features/` and `src/hooks/` **already contained no imports of React components at all**. The foundation was far better than expected, so this was not a large refactor — just clearing the few remaining couplings and pinning the boundary.

highlights.zh: **清掉的耦合**：① `announcer`（屏幕阅读器播报服务）原先定义在 `src/ui/AriaLiveRegion.tsx` 里——**一个 `.tsx`**，于是走带与曲风试听的 hook 为了播报一句话要 import 一个 React 组件。它本质是**事件**不是视图，已移到 `src/platform/announcer.ts`：logic 负责发布，哪个界面在挂载就由哪个界面决定怎么显示。② `NavTab` 从 `components/Header.tsx` 移到 `app/navigation.ts`（「应用有哪些目的地」不是 Header 的 props 形状，domain 的教程数据与 logic 的快捷键 hook 都在用它）。③ `ParameterDimension` / `GenreRailItem` / `UnsavedDecision` 三个类型原来都定义在组件里、被 logic 反向 import，现已回到 `src/features/sequencer/` 的归属地；组件仍 re-export 以兼…
highlights.en: **The couplings removed**: (1) `announcer` (the screen-reader announcement service) was defined inside `src/ui/AriaLiveRegion.tsx` — a `.tsx` — so the transport and genre-audition hooks imported a React component just to announce a sentence. It is an *event*, not a view, so it moved to `src/platform/announcer.ts`: logic publishes, and whichever view is mounted decides how to show it.
